errors.evidence: From the DPS clues, single out the class with a bear form (used when “a bear is attacking the boss”) – this is the Druid.
errors.description: The agent assumes that the bear form is exclusive to the Druid class without verifying other possible classes.

errors.evidence: Determine which DPS remaining class is associated with elemental “ice” and “fire” magic – that is the Mage (using its frost and fire specializations).
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the Mage is the only class associated with ice and fire abilities.

errors.evidence: Verify that the armor types match: Paladin (plate), Mage and Priest (cloth) and the remaining two (Druid and Demon Hunter) typically wearing leather; thus the “two plate, two cloth” count is satisfied by the Paladin plus one other plate not present, meaning the non‐plate DPS are not using plate armor.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the Druid and Demon Hunter typically wear leather armor.

errors.evidence: Compile the deduced five unique classes: Demon Hunter, Druid, Mage, Paladin, and Priest.

errors.evidence: Arrange these class names in alphabetical order, separated by commas.

errors.evidence: The holy‐tank is very often a Paladin (they wear plate armor and use holy spells as a Protection Paladin).
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the Paladin is the only class that can fulfill the holy-tank role.

errors.evidence: The holy healer is usually a Priest (a cloth wearer).
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the Priest is the only class that can fulfill the holy-healer role.

errors.evidence: “Ice and fire” thus indicate separate specializations where one DPS is dealing frost (ice) and one fire damage (fire). The typical spellcaster of this sort is the Mage.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the Mage is the only class associated with ice and fire abilities.

errors.evidence: “A bear from the group” is an unmistakable reference to a druid in bear form (as druids can shape‐shift into a bear and they are known for doing so in PvE).
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that the bear form is exclusive to the Druid class.

errors.evidence: “Metamorphosis” is the signature ability of the Demon Hunter.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumes that Metamorphosis is exclusive to the Demon Hunter class.
